The Mud Fish is a fish native to the region or [[Tear]] and is known in the [[Maule]] as a cheap and very bad tasting, but cheap fish that the poor of the country buy.

==Insult==

That while in the fish is cheap and bad tasting is well known, the use of "Mud Fish" in an insult involving dirty, tasteless and bad work is a common occurrence in Tear.
